hook: Microsoft unveiled a new Surface laptop built for AI developers
hooks: Microsoft unveiled a new Surface laptop built for AI developers
The Surface Laptop Ultra runs on Nvidia’s RTX Spark SoC
Microsoft says the RTX Spark Dev Box delivers one petaflop of AI compute
what_happened: Microsoft announced the Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia RTX Spark SoC and a RTX Spark Dev Box that claims one petaflop AI performance.
why_it_matters: Microsoft says developers can run AI models locally on a laptop or a dedicated box, a move away from cloud-backed AI.
the_catch: Microsoft's one-petaflop figure is its own claim, and Ars says questions about security and user acceptance of local AI still remain.
caption: Microsoft introduced the Surface Laptop Ultra and RTX Spark Dev Box, hardware aimed at local AI development. How will you use local AI on your own machine?
alt_text: A five-slide carousel on Microsoft's new Surface Laptop Ultra and RTX Spark Dev Box, built around Nvidia's RTX Spark chip and aimed at running AI models locally, with Microsoft's one-petaflop claim and the open questions about local AI.

es.hook: Microsoft presentó una nueva laptop Surface diseñada para desarrolladores de IA
es.what_happened: Microsoft anunció la Surface Laptop Ultra, que incorpora un SoC Nvidia RTX Spark y una RTX Spark Dev Box que promete un rendimiento de IA de un petaflop
es.why_it_matters: Microsoft afirma que los desarrolladores podrán ejecutar modelos de IA localmente en una laptop o en una caja dedicada, lo que representa un alejamiento de la IA basada en la nube
es.the_catch: La cifra de un petaflop proviene de la propia Microsoft, y Ars señala que aún quedan sin resolver preguntas sobre la seguridad y la aceptación de la IA local por parte de los usuarios
